sql: SELECT MIN(datediff(CAST(scheduled_date AS DATE), CAST(bank_changed_at AS DATE))) AS min_days, MAX(datediff(CAST(scheduled_date AS DATE), CAST(bank_changed_at AS DATE))) AS max_days, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item WHERE amount_usd > 100000 AND bank_changed_at IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
